question: How is the goddess of gods characterized in relation to the eight Bhairavas and their mothers?
premises: The goddess of gods has many divisions.
A group of eight Bhairavas is implied.
Mothers associated with the eight Bhairavas are named.
inference: The many-divided goddess of gods is associated with the mothers of the eight Bhairavas.
plain_english: The goddess of gods, of many divisions, is accompanied by the mothers of the eight Bhairavas.
